dedupe_keys.name: rejets des stations d epuration urbaine

description: REJETS DES STATIONS D'EPURATION URBAINE is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agence de l'Eau Artois-Picardie. Localized discharge points of urban wastewater treatment plants (STEU, STEP) in the Artois-Picardie basin Situation at the end of 10/2024. Coverage: Agence de l'Eau Artois-Picardie. The portal shows the English title as "REJECTS OF URBAN EPERATION STATIONS" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agence de l'Eau Artois-Picardie. Its keywords include impact-sur-lenvironnement, donnees-qualitatives, artois-picardie, donnees-ouvertes, epuration, donnees-descriptives. The listing shows 6 download or service links in 0-HTTP--LINK, WWW:LINK, OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
